notes.title: Stealth update should be live :3c
notes.content:
A potential sequence-breaking bug has been fixed with thanks to input from the user Saraphel.

The bug related to how many items the player would have in the inventory and how many the puzzle would need for your to have to proceed. At a later part of the game you'd have given/spent many of the items and you'd be one item short of being able to solve the puzzle. This has been fixed now.

Thank you to all the users who help with reporting bugs and other issues. :3

notes.title: New update with some hotfixes coming soon! :'3
notes.content:
Apparently there was a scaling issue with one of the inventory items so it appeared as one pixel large in the inventory screen. This has been fixed.

Also there are some issues if you load a game right after completing the game without exiting and reentering the game first, but it is being looked into now.

Please let me know if you find anything. These bugs were discovered by a player just now and we appreciate your feedback and do what we can in order to fix it.
